role: LWJGL mouse device wrapper: cursor grab/release and the per-frame mouse deltas fed into look changes.
scope_reason: SPEC records input as effects, not devices: look yaw/pitch arrive as per-tick look ops, so the device wrapper is not part of the gated path; the human client's SDL input sits outside the tick.
notes: Not ported; csrc/play/play.c reads the OS devices itself for the human client and agents send look deltas directly.
